claim: Capital One has legally finalized and completed its merger with Discover Financial as of early 2024.

annotation.adjudication_rationale: The merger agreement was announced subject to ongoing regulatory approvals and has not been completed in early 2024.

gold_evidence.exact_quote: The transaction is expected to close in late 2024 or early 2025, subject to satisfaction of customary closing conditions, including regulatory approvals.
The proposed deal remains subject to approval by the Federal Reserve and the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency.
